explanation: The Almighty Creator who spoke through the prophet Zechariah about His wrath over Israel's sins and His promise of rebuilding.
The divine anger against the people's disobedience, described in the chapter as a powerful wind or storm from the east.
These are the visual experiences Zechariah received while sleeping, where God showed him future events and judgment over the nations.
Symbols of God's angels patrolling the earth to report on the state of the world back to the Lord.
The holy city in Israel that lay in ruins, but which God promises will be rebuilt and filled with people again.
The term associated with the measuring rod or cord used to determine the boundaries of the future city of Jerusalem.
God's warning that the nations surrounding Israel will be afraid when He intervenes to protect His people.
